subject: Request to reactivate expired trial credits for BrightPetro
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa@brightpetro.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial credits expired — can we get an extension?

Hi Jonas,

We were in the middle of an evaluation of Redwood Inference and noticed our trial access and free credits expired yesterday. We were testing performance across some internal models (latency/throughput comparisons) and the expiration cut off an important end-to-end test.

Can you reactivate the trial or grant additional credits so our infra team can finish the benchmark? We expect to move to a POC + deeper evaluation if we can validate the runtime under our steady-state load.

Attached: usage-snapshot.csv (shows the calls that failed after expiration).

Thanks — appreciate any help.

Lisa Chen
Staff ML Engineer | BrightPetro
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@brightpetro.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — can we get an extension?

Hi Lisa — thanks for the heads up and for sending the snapshot. Sorry about the interruption.

Short answer: yes, we can typically reactivate trials for active evaluations. I'll loop in our finance and SE leads to get temporary credit applied. Before I do that: could you confirm the target acceptance criteria for the POC (latency target / throughput target / sample model size), and whether you need a full 30-day reactivation or a shorter window? That helps us size the promo credit.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 20-min sync today or tomorrow to confirm scope (Avery can help with an infra runbook)
- I’ll request approval for a 30-day reactivation with up to 50k free credits (pending sign-off)

If you’re available, I can set up a call at 3pm PT today.

Best,
Jonas Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Request: promotional credit + 30-day trial reactivation for BrightPetro (evaluation)

Monica / Avery —

BrightPetro (Lisa Chen) had their trial expire 9/9 while running latency+throughput tests. They are actively evaluating Redwood for an inference path for internal instrumented models — potential ARR in the low six figures if the POC succeeds.

Ask:
- Approve a 30-day trial reactivation and promotional free credits to allow them to finish the last set of benchmarks.
- Suggested amount: 50,000 free tokens/units (we can cap at lower if finance prefers).

Rationale:
- Customer is mid-stage evaluation, engaged, and has scheduled demos with Avery.
- We lose visibility and momentum if they re-run on other platforms.

Attachments: deal-summary.pdf (quick notes on opportunity and next steps).

If you can approve, I’ll notify the customer and set the expiration accordingly.

Thanks — Jonas

- Credits: 40,000 token units applied (promo)
- New expiration: 2025-10-15T23:59:00Z (30 days from today)
